query:
FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T05:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:55:00Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
  AND message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*"
| GROK message "%{DATA}ipAddress=\"%{IP:ip_address}\"%{DATA}"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY ip_address
| SORT count DESC
